from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485207/attempts/aebe2cf00e3243528294ba8447492ab6/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marked = set()
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1:
            marked.update((r, c) for c in range(w))
    for c in range(w):
        if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1:
            marked.update((r, c) for r in range(h))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in marked:
        out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
p=base/'task-b833ab44.py'
p.write_text(code)
print(p)
